svg.title: Latest Scriptw versus V8: elapsed time and process memory

cc:Work.dc:title: Latest Scriptw versus V8: elapsed time and process memory
cc:Work.dc:description: Latest verified Scriptw versus V8, all 17 fresh Store/Realm workloads. Measured 2026-10-26 16:24 UTC; compiler 736f0f1206c581e70048467f7d4423e1efed8bdd. Lower is better. Paired bars use a shared zero-based linear scale within each section: median elapsed milliseconds and median post-execution process RSS in MiB. RSS includes host/runtime, setup and retained warmup effects; it is not live JavaScript heap usage or a peak. Each runtime has 14 measured observations from two rounds of seven after ten warmups. Existing-Realm calls are separate. Source report SHA-256: 3ce6d8adfb1a50b4bdeee8aacad87ab929138dddfe5b1607e3c3a4b6b378e54b. Archive SHA-256: 846fcb51df8e82801fcade6caab22b22f8adab994a1f5c849f5e8c93233414de. sort-reverse-128.js: V8 0.017 ms, Scriptw 2.068 ms; V8 RSS 52.8 MiB, Scriptw RSS 87.5 MiB. sort-reverse-512.js: V8 0.106 ms, Scriptw 7.935 ms; V8 RSS 53.6 MiB, Scriptw RSS 97.2 MiB. sort-sorted-512.js: V8 0.099 ms, Scriptw 6.453 ms; V8 RSS 53.6 MiB, Scriptw RSS 93.3 MiB. to-sorted-512.js: V8 0.098 ms, Scriptw 6.939 ms; V8 RSS 53.6 MiB, Scriptw RSS 95.1 MiB. join-1024.js: V8 0.049 ms, Scriptw 6.985 ms; V8 RSS 53.9 MiB, Scriptw RSS 95.8 MiB. join-4096.js: V8 0.572 ms, Scriptw 26.613 ms; V8 RSS 61.1 MiB, Scriptw RSS 100.0 MiB. join-mixed-1024.js: V8 0.192 ms, Scriptw 7.583 ms; V8 RSS 57.2 MiB, Scriptw RSS 96.1 MiB. numeric-loop-10000.js: V8 0.124 ms, Scriptw 1.071 ms; V8 RSS 59.2 MiB, Scriptw RSS 79.7 MiB. numeric-loop-50000.js: V8 0.740 ms, Scriptw 3.713 ms; V8 RSS 61.1 MiB, Scriptw RSS 78.7 MiB. folded-string-4096.js: V8 0.194 ms, Scriptw 1.534 ms; V8 RSS 59.1 MiB, Scriptw RSS 83.1 MiB. dynamic-string-4096.js: V8 0.195 ms, Scriptw 2.507 ms; V8 RSS 61.3 MiB, Scriptw RSS 83.0 MiB. integer.js: V8 1.691 ms, Scriptw 4.321 ms; V8 RSS 60.0 MiB, Scriptw RSS 82.1 MiB. objects.js: V8 0.048 ms, Scriptw 3.581 ms; V8 RSS 53.9 MiB, Scriptw RSS 88.0 MiB. retained-objects.js: V8 2.896 ms, Scriptw 119.557 ms; V8 RSS 71.5 MiB, Scriptw RSS 100.1 MiB. join-empty-1024.js: V8 0.159 ms, Scriptw 2.089 ms; V8 RSS 58.5 MiB, Scriptw RSS 84.6 MiB. join-singleton-1024.js: V8 0.164 ms, Scriptw 3.003 ms; V8 RSS 59.4 MiB, Scriptw RSS 84.5 MiB. join-small-1024.js: V8 0.292 ms, Scriptw 3.023 ms; V8 RSS 60.9 MiB, Scriptw RSS 82.8 MiB.
